description: This file defines the HomeScreen composable for an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It constructs the main UI for the home screen, showing a list of installed apps with toggle options for hiding and locking them, including a navigation bar for moving between different sections of the app.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Defines the composable function that displays the home screen with app list, navigation bar, and theme.

methods.name: launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an app given its package info, handling exceptions silently.
